layouts.name: Family gear wall
layouts.summary: four rear bays, with individual wide backpack spaces, a snow-racer bay and flexible small-item shelves. Shallow wall-mounted shelves preserve the best rear access.
layouts.equipment: 3 large backpacks + flexible fourth opening; footwear shelves left empty (count unknown); 3×22 L + 2×5 L boxes; 1 snow racer; shared right-wall gear.

layouts.name: Deep camping store
layouts.summary: Two deep towers accommodate three individual large-pack positions and flexible small-item shelves; a separate sled bay has upper shelves. Two supplied BROR shelves remain spare to preserve tall openings.
layouts.equipment: 3 large backpacks; footwear shelves left empty (count unknown); 3×22 L + 4×11 L boxes; 1 snow racer; shared right-wall gear.

layouts.name: Grab-and-go gear bench
layouts.summary: Three wide backpacks sit at 1.10 m pickup height on two low racks. Flexible storage below; snow racer and upper boxes to the right. Best handling access, least boxed storage.
layouts.equipment: 3 large backpacks + a duffel below; footwear shelves left empty (count unknown); 2×22 L boxes; 1 snow racer; shared right-wall gear.

layouts.name: Budget 60 cm rack
layouts.summary: Rear storage now spans 268 cm of the 283 cm wall. The stock rack is joined by a 106.0 cm wide custom timber bay at the same 60 cm depth: two full-width upper shelves, two narrow lower shelves and a 65 cm clear upright snow-racer slot. Upper shelf surfaces are 145 and 195 cm.
layouts.equipment: Backpacks in the main rack; boxes / smaller bags in the narrow shelves; snow racer in its dedicated slot with storage above it. Custom extension is a dimensioned concept, not a catalogue product or engineered load rating. Budget includes a provisional 1,500 kr materials allowance plus 600 kr for fixings/backing; labour and delivery excluded. Three of four supplied rack shelves are installed to preserve loaded-backpack openings; one remains spare.

layouts.name: Bikes under raised shelves
layouts.summary: Rear shelf surfaces at 145 and 195 cm; no rear uprights or floor rack. Lower bracket tips at approximately 123 cm clear the 110 cm bike envelope. Less storage: a separate location for the snow racer and large loaded backpacks is still unresolved.
layouts.equipment: Bike-priority study. Rear shelves are for smaller / flatter gear. This is not yet a complete solution for all existing belongings.
